response.rationale: Ranged damage carries the highest plan weight (8.0) among the offered stats and has the top advisor score (8). Attack speed (7.0) is a close second; engineering and elemental damage are not in the plan.

Plan is ranged-only, and Revolver is ranged with ranged-damage scaling. It adds a new Gun-set piece for range bonuses and is affordable at 26 of 29 gold. Landmines are tool-type and weak for this build.
Plan weights ranged damage highest (8) among offered stats; advisor scores it best (8). Range and speed are weak here. Ranged build suits the kiting arbiter.

Harvesting is already 23, past the plan's 21+ rush threshold. Ranged damage is the plan's next priority (weight 8) and sits at only 2. Harvesting +8 is tied on score but adds economy the run doesn't need yet.
Third Double Barrel Shotgun tier 1 merges with the two owned into a tier 2 shotgun, freeing slots at 6 weapons. Ranged, Gun set bonus, affordable at 59 gold. Laser 1 would not merge.

Lifesteal is a plan stat (weight 6.0) and has the top advisor score (6). Range is worthless here (score 0). Armor and speed are plan-aligned but lower-weighted; lifesteal adds sustain for the survival target.
Laser Gun is ranged, matching the plan. Board already holds three laser_gun_2, so this buy should combine into a tier-up and free slots on a full six-weapon board. Affordable at 51 of 204 gold.
Plan weights ranged damage highest among offered options (8), advisor scores it 8. Dodge and armor are lower-weight; hp is at full and kill speed is the ranged kit's defence per the notes.
Acid (117g) has the top advisor score and adds +8 max HP, matching the plan's max_hp weight and a 30-HP kit. Its -2 dodge is a minor cost. Gold stays at 146 afterward.

Plan weights stat_ranged_damage (8) above attack speed (7), and the offer scores higher (16 vs 14). Ranged kit at wave 9 with 51/51 HP and near-zero damage taken, so offence is the right pick. Elemental and melee options score 0.
Feather is the only on-plan item here: ranged damage plus dodge, cheap at 43 with 371 gold. Blood Donation's +40 harvesting overshoots harvest_cap 40 (already at 36) and drains 1 HP/s on a 50-HP run.

Sunglasses has the top advisor score (11) and adds crit chance, which the plan weights (4.5). Its -1 armor is a minor cost. Affordable at 104 of 209 gold, leaving room for later buys. Frozen Heart (7.5) costs 180.
Third Double Barrel tier 3 should merge with the two owned copies into a tier 4 ranged weapon, adding damage without a new slot. On-plan ranged, affordable at 276 gold, advisor score 110.
